All of our clients live in the South Bay region - no driving long distances for a short shift.We have work. The more availability & flexibility you offer us, the more work we are able to offer you - and we have work - lots and lots of work!Our hiring time & process is quick and easy. We are capable of scheduling several Orientations a week so the time between application to interview to Orientation could be less than 48 hours! No minimum or maximum is required; we will work with your schedule.Job Responsibilities:Meal Preparation.Light Housekeeping.Standby Assistance.Medication Reminders.Companionship.Personal Care (bathing/dressing).Transportation etc.
